name: Urth Apparel Inc.
description: Urth Apparel Inc. is a custom apparel manufacturer based in Newport Beach, California, that takes clothing brands from concept through production. Services include product development, fashion and technical design, fabric and trim sourcing, pattern making, grading, marker making, sampling, cutting and sewing, screen printing, sublimation, heat transfer, finishing, packaging and inspection. Production is split by origin: luxury clothing in Italy, knitwear and basics in Peru, and specialty technical apparel in the USA. The company runs separate production lines for tees, tanks and polos, emphasizes sustainable and organic materials, and ships orders by ocean or air freight.
